game.name: Minigore 2: Zombies
game.desc:
Twin-stick zombie shooter by Mountain Sheep. John Gore and friends against endless waves of furries and zombies across five arenas.
This port runs the game's original Android native library directly on Linux through a NativeActivity loader, so no emulator is involved. You supply your own APK.
Left stick walks. A, R1 or R2 fire. The menus are touch-only in this build, so the d-pad moves an on-screen cursor and B taps with it.
